title: Gixxer SF 150 (Sport Black)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Suzuki Gixxer SF 150 (Sport Black) is engineered for responsive agility and high-rpm engine exhilaration. At its heart lies a 150cc powertrain delivering 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 108 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Aggressive Forward Tuck posture paired with a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 5.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
